definitions: Having no more patience or strength to deal with a difficult situation.
Exhausted of all options or resources.
examples: After hours of trying to fix the computer, I was at the end of my rope.
She felt at the end of her rope with all the demands of her new job.
The detective was at the end of his rope trying to solve the cold case.
lemma: at the end of one's rope
synonyms: at the end of one's tether
source: at the end of one's rope
